concept: Review and integration: what being brave feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of doing something scary, speaking up for fairness, and trying something new — which feels bravest to you?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'courage' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
